system.description:
The siege companies of Dul Khagul and every army that has had to break a gate: breaking lines, shattering formations, holding ground.

  • Siege Master: Advantage on Strength checks to break, smash or force open objects.
    • 9th level: your weapon attacks deal double damage to objects and structures, and Cleaving Fury carries through to a second enemy.
  • Siege-Bound: Advantage on checks about clan etiquette and military structure, and you are recognised as a warrior of note by any company that has stormed a wall.
